description.silhouette: Collapsed state of the same three decks: identical abutments, sills, moss and grass, sagging stringer stubs and remaining boards at each bank, broken trestle piles and drifting board fragments in the open middle
description.colors: The overgrown timber palette charred towards the blast in the middle: charcoal crust on broken ends, warm unburnt and mossy wood near the banks, grey stone unchanged
description.anatomy: Stringer stubs of 0.25 to 0.9 m sag from the sills; up to four rows of remaining boards with missing pieces; broken piles near the deck edges in the third and sixth cell; every drifting fragment stays inside one cell so the runtime cuts never split it.

standard.label: Watchtower timber with damp mossy deck margins
